User.title: User
User.description: Represents any user in the system. A user has a base role and can have specific, elevated roles at different premises.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User (matches Firebase Auth UID).

role.description: The user's base role, defining their default access level (e.g., 'visitor', 'admin').

phone.description: User's local phone number, without the country code.

is_verified.description: Flag indicating if the user's phone is verified.

is_active.description: Flag indicating if the user account is active. Defaults to true.

token_balance_visitor.description: The user's token balance when acting as a visitor.

active_checkin_id.description: ID of the current active visit, if any.

photo_url.description: URL of the user's profile image.

city.description: The city associated with the user (primarily for Staff).

premise_roles.description: A map of premise IDs to a list of the user's roles at that premise (e.g., owner, host).

vehicles.description: A list of the user's registered vehicles.

selected_vehicle_number.description: The number plate of the vehicle currently selected for check-in.

products.description: A list of products the visitor deals in. Maximum 10 products.

AdminRole.title: Admin Role
AdminRole.description: A document indicating a user has admin privileges. The existence of a document with the user's UID as the ID is sufficient.

Premise.title: Premise
Premise.description: Represents a physical location or building managed in the system.

city.description: City where the premise is located.

is_active.description: Whether the premise is currently active.

owner_id.description: The UID of the User who owns this premise.

ownerName.description: Denormalized name of the premise's owner.

token_balance.description: The token balance for this specific premise.

agent_id.description: The ID of the agent who brought this premise onboard.

categoryId.description: The ID of the premise's category.

categoryName.description: Denormalized name of the premise's category.

host_count.description: The number of hosts assigned to this premise.

gatekeeper_count.description: The number of gatekeepers assigned to this premise.

visit_count.description: The total number of visits that have occurred at this premise.

staff.description: A list of staff members (hosts, gatekeepers) at this premise.

identity.description: A unique identifier for the host within the premise, like a flat number or department name.

Visit.title: Visit
Visit.description: Represents a single visit record, as an audit trail.

visitor_name.description: Denormalized name of the visitor for quick display.

host_name.description: Denormalized name of the host for quick display.

premise_id.description: Reference to the Premise where the visit occurred.

expiresAt.description: The server timestamp when this visit document should be automatically deleted by the Firestore TTL policy.

visitor_snapshot_url.description: Permanent URL to the visitor's image at time of check-in.

Rating.title: Rating
Rating.description: Represents a single rating given by a host to a visitor for a specific visit.

visitId.description: The ID of the visit being rated.

visitorId.description: The UID of the visitor being rated.

hostId.description: The UID of the host giving the rating.

premiseId.description: The premise where the visit occurred.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the rating was created.

PremiseBlock.title: Premise Block
PremiseBlock.description: Represents a premise-wide block on a visitor, initiated by an owner. The document ID is the visitor's UID.

blockedBy.description: The UID of the owner who initiated the block.

visitorName.description: Denormalized name of the blocked visitor.

visitorPhotoUrl.description: Denormalized photo URL of the blocked visitor.

HostBlock.title: Host Block
HostBlock.description: Represents a host-specific block on a visitor. The document ID is the visitor's UID.

blockedBy.description: The UID of the host who initiated the block.

visitorName.description: Denormalized name of the blocked visitor.

visitorPhotoUrl.description: Denormalized photo URL of the blocked visitor.

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.description: Global configuration settings for the application, managed by Admins.

export_history_days_owner.description: Number of days of history an Owner can export.

export_history_days_host.description: Number of days of history a Host can export.

export_history_days_visitor.description: Number of days of history a Visitor can export.

pdf_export_cost_host.description: Token cost for a Host to export history as a PDF.

csv_export_cost_host.description: Token cost for a Host to export history as a CSV.

pdf_export_cost_visitor.description: Token cost for a Visitor to export history as a PDF.

csv_export_cost_visitor.description: Token cost for a Visitor to export history as a CSV.

star_rating_cost.description: The number of tokens to deduct from a visitor when they receive a star rating.

block_visitor_cost.description: The number of tokens to deduct from an owner when they block a visitor from their premise.

unblock_visitor_cost.description: The number of tokens to deduct from an owner when they unblock a visitor from their premise.

block_visitor_cost_host.description: The number of tokens to deduct from a host when they block a visitor.

unblock_visitor_cost_host.description: The number of tokens to deduct from a host when they unblock a visitor.

log_ttl_days.description: The Time-to-Live (TTL) for audit log documents, in days.

visit_ttl_days.description: The Time-to-Live (TTL) for visit documents, in days.

currency.description: The currency for token exchange rates.

token_exchange_rate.description: How much 1 token is worth in the selected currency.

gst_rate.description: The Goods and Services Tax (GST) rate as a percentage (e.g., 18 for 18%).

agent_commission_rate.description: The commission percentage for agents on premise token purchases.

default_country_code.description: The default country code for phone numbers (e.g., '+91').

phone_number_length.description: The required length for phone numbers (e.g., 10 for India).

allow_unverified_checkin.description: If true, allows visitors to generate a check-in QR code even if their phone number is not verified.

Agent.title: Agent
Agent.description: Represents a field agent who helps onboard new premises.

commission_balance.description: The agent's current commission balance in the system currency.

AgentLedgerEntry.title: Agent Ledger Entry
AgentLedgerEntry.description: A record of a single credit or debit transaction in an agent's commission ledger.

balance_after.description: The agent's new total balance after this transaction.

Announcement.title: Announcement
Announcement.description: Represents an announcement created by an admin for specific user roles and/or geographic locations.

targetRoles.description: Array of user roles to target.

targetStates.description: Array of state IDs to target. An empty array or absence of this field means no states are explicitly targeted.

targetDistricts.description: Array of district IDs to target. An empty array or absence of this field means no districts are explicitly targeted.

targetCities.description: Array of city IDs to target. An empty array or absence of this field means no cities are explicitly targeted.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the announcement was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the announcement was last updated.

Log.title: Log
Log.description: Represents an immutable audit log entry for a significant action performed in the system by any user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the log entry.

actorId.description: The UID of the user who performed the action.

actorName.description: The denormalized name of the actor for display.

actorRole.description: The denormalized role of the actor at the time of the action.

action.description: A string code representing the action, e.g., 'CREATE_ANNOUNCEMENT'.

timestamp.description: The server timestamp of when the action occurred.

expiresAt.description: The server timestamp when this log document should be automatically deleted by the Firestore TTL policy.

description.description: A human-readable description of the event.

tokenChange.description: The amount of tokens added or deducted in this action.

premiseId.description: The premise ID associated with the log event, if any.

context.description: Additional contextual IDs related to the log event.

District.title: District
District.description: Represents a district within a state.

stateId.description: The ID of the parent state.

stateName.description: Denormalized name of the parent state.

City.title: City
City.description: Represents a city within a district.

districtId.description: The ID of the parent district.

districtName.description: Denormalized name of the parent district.

stateId.description: Denormalized ID of the parent state.

stateName.description: Denormalized name of the parent state.

CheckinToken.title: Check-in Token
CheckinToken.description: A short-lived, single-use token for visitor check-ins.

userId.description: The UID of the user this token belongs to.

WhatsAppOtp.title: WhatsApp OTP
WhatsAppOtp.description: A temporary document to store a one-time password for WhatsApp verification.

PremiseCategory.title: Premise Category
PremiseCategory.description: Defines a category for premises with specific token deduction rates.

ContactSubmission.title: Contact Submission
ContactSubmission.description: Represents a single submission from the public contact form.
